note: mass_solid_g is the mass of the part printed 100 % solid, an upper bound. At the baseline settings a part weighs roughly 55 to 80 % of it; weigh the real parts.

parts.name: Stack plate, telemetry (top)
parts.note: Ø6.2 rod holes with M3 clamp screws and nut slots; three M3 insert holes for the receiver / GPS standoffs.

parts.name: Stack plate, flight computer (middle)
parts.note: Four M3 insert holes at (±38, ±22) for the 9 mm standoffs under the carrier board.

parts.name: Stack plate, batteries (bottom of the stack)
parts.note: Two strap slots 12 × 3 mm at y = ±36.

parts.name: Landing frame (diamond, 4 hinge clevises)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Printed upside down so the clevis ears point up. Hinge bore Ø3.2 for an M3 bolt.

parts.name: Gimbal mount (square frame on the rods)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Carries the outer ring on two M3 pivots (X axis), the servo-1 bracket underneath and four leg-brace anchor holes.

parts.name: Gimbal outer ring (with 36T sector, axis 1)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Printed upside down: sector fin points up. Two 683ZZ bearings in the X bosses; Y pads carry the collar pivots. Ream the Ø7 bearing bores.

parts.name: Gimbal inner collar (with 36T sector, axis 2)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Clamps the Ø42 tube with four M3 set screws. Two 683ZZ bearings in the Y bosses.

parts.name: Pinion, 18 teeth, module 1
parts.note: Ø4.7 bore for the 25T servo spline. Rotate on the spline until it meshes (gap centred on the sector tooth).

parts.name: Servo bracket, axis 1 (under the mount)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Two M3 × 10 into the mount inserts; four M2 self-tap holes for a 23 × 12 mm servo.

parts.name: Servo bracket, axis 2 (on top of the ring)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Two M3 × 10 into the ring inserts; four M2 self-tap holes for the servo.

parts.name: Motor plate, upper (tube socket + motor A)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Ø42.3 socket for the carbon tube (epoxy + two M3 set screws). Motor pattern Ø19, four M3, reached through the tube bore.

parts.name: Motor plate, lower (motor B)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Motor B stands on it; screws from below.

parts.name: Cage arm, upper
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Half-lap onto the plate stub, two M3 × 12 with nuts; tip bolts to the strut.

parts.name: Cage arm, lower
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Same as the upper arm, on the lower plate.

parts.name: Cage strut (60 mm)
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: M3 inserts in both ends (screws M3 × 10 through the arms) and two on the outer face for the guard-ring tabs.

parts.name: Guard-ring arc (120°)
parts.note: Tabs screw onto the struts with M3 × 10.

parts.name: Leg hinge fitting
parts.material: PA-CF (or PETG for a first set)
parts.note: Ø8.2 socket for the Ø8 carbon leg (epoxy), Ø3.2 pin bore. Tongue 12.6 mm sits between the frame lug ears.

parts.name: Brace clip
parts.note: Slides onto the leg, M3 grub screw; Ø2.2 eyelet for the Ø1.6 brace wire.
